purpose: Show kinetic energy arriving from the net force's work, one link of the chain per stage, so K = 0.5 m v^2 is reached rather than quoted.
required_elements: trolley at the start and end of the interval
read_order: trolley at the start and end of the interval
instance_constraints: The net force is constant and along the displacement.
The trolley's mass does not change.
accessibility: Every force and quantity is labelled in text.
Results are written as text, not carried by colour alone.
misleading_alternatives: Starting from K = 0.5 m v^2 as a definition with no link to work.
Using v = u + a t, which brings in time the derivation does not need.

correspondence.in_words: The net force's component along the path, constant over the interval.

correspondence.element: trolley at the start and end of the interval
correspondence.in_words: The displacement between the two positions.
Final kinetic energy minus initial kinetic energy, equal to the net work.

purpose: Show why lifting slowly stores m g h as gravitational potential energy: the applied force balances the weight, the speed does not change, so the lifting work is stored.
required_elements: box lifted slowly through height h
zero net work of the slow lift
read_order: box lifted slowly through height h
zero net work of the slow lift
instance_constraints: The lift is slow: speed unchanged, acceleration zero.
Near Earth's surface: g constant over h.
accessibility: Every force and quantity is labelled in text.
Results are written as text, not carried by colour alone.
misleading_alternatives: Saying the lifting work 'disappears' because the box ends at rest.
Taking the applied force larger than m g throughout a slow lift.

correspondence.in_words: The weight m g, which the applied force balances in a slow lift.

correspondence.element: box lifted slowly through height h

correspondence.in_words: The stored increase, m g h.

reveal_stages.label: Net work zero
